interface.signature: routes: List[List[int]], S: int, T: int -> int

preconditions.description: The number of bus routes must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(route) <= 10**5 for route in routes)
preconditions.description: Each bus route must have a length between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= stop < 10**6 for route in routes for stop in route)
preconditions.description: All bus stops in the routes must be non-negative integers less than 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == -1 if not any(S in route and T in route for route in routes) else True
postconditions.description: If it is not possible to reach the destination, the output must be -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout >= 1 if any(S in route and T in route for route in routes) else True
postconditions.description: If it is possible to reach the destination, the output must be the least number of buses taken.
